name: board
description: A kanban board for the work a business runs: jobs, listings, candidates, client projects. Server-rendered on Hono, on the project's Postgres, shaped by its AI; runs in dev on its machine and in production on Cloudflare.

scripts.test: tsx --import ./test/pin-config.mjs --test --test-reporter=./test/reporter.mjs test/config.test.ts test/helpers.test.ts test/guard.test.ts test/db.test.ts test/scripts.test.ts src/data/test/cli.test.ts
scripts.deploy: node scripts/migrate.mjs && npm run build && python3 ~/tools/taskandtool.py deploy dist --worker build/worker.mjs --flag nodejs_compat
